Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: alpha-transparent 8-frame game character sprite sheet.
Primary request: draw EXACTLY EIGHT new fully articulated poses of ONE approved soccer character, maintaining identity, face, hairstyle, proportions, clothing, equipment, color blocks, and camera style.
Grid: landscape exactly 2:1 aspect, ideally 2048x1024 pixels. Four columns and TWO rows of EQUAL SQUARE CELLS. Exactly ONE complete pose per cell, eight total, row-major order. Invisible cell boundaries, no labels and no page margins. Each figure about 65% of cell height, at least 12% transparent padding around all sides including hair, hands and extended boots. Shared ground-root at cell x=50%, y=82%. All poses must be the SAME BODY SCALE. Character drawings must NEVER touch or cross their cell edges. Prefer extra empty spacing over larger drawings.
Style/camera: match the approved slightly elevated orthographic 2.5D cartoon game art; bold dark navy outline, playful expressions, chunky sports shoes, crisp simplified hand-painted cel shading, warm upper-left light. See the face and body sides in forward directions. Not a vertical overhead view, not a flat drawing rotated around the sheet.
Constraints: genuinely transparent alpha background in every gap. No ground, NO shadows, NO ball, NO speed trails, NO effects, NO props, NO UI, NO text, NO logos, NO cell borders, NO watermark, NO other characters. Exactly eight isolated full bodies with huge empty transparent gutters between them.
Input images: Image 1 is the approved character identity, proportions and elevated camera reference.
Subject: Wind Shuttle: slim teal-haired adult female runner, cream cropped sports jacket with teal cuffs, dark loose trousers, chunky cream/teal wing-accent sneakers, mischievous smile. Light springy run.
Action: eight sequential frames of ONE COMPLETE RUN CYCLE. ALL EIGHT FACE SCREEN LOWER RIGHT (southeast); side of face and torso visible. Opposing arm-leg swing; alternate which anatomical leg is forward. Read left to right, top row then bottom row:
0 LEFT foot forward contacting ground, RIGHT leg behind; right arm forward.
1 Left leg bears weight, torso lower, right heel lifts.
2 RIGHT leg swings forward and passes under body; left leg extends backward.
3 Right knee leads forward, left foot pushes off; airborne.
4 RIGHT foot forward contacting ground, LEFT leg behind; left arm forward.
5 Right leg bears weight, torso lower, left heel lifts.
6 LEFT leg swings forward and passes under body; right leg extends backward.
7 Left knee leads forward, right foot pushes off; airborne, smoothly leading into frame 0.
Show eight visibly different running poses, NOT repeated still images. Match scale and root; only subtle vertical bounce and small secondary hair/clothing motion.
Input image 2 is a TECHNICAL POSE DIAGRAM, not an art style. Follow each of its eight separate skeletal poses in row-major order: these establish the leg and arm JOINT POSITIONS and DIFFERENT STRIDE PHASES. The turquoise limb is the near-side anatomical limb, purple is far-side; do NOT borrow their colors or mannequin look. Preserve the character's approved outfit colors and elevated view from Image 1. Articulate the actual dressed character to follow the different joint configurations. Keep drawings reduced to the diagram's body scale and spacious gutters. Especially frames 2 and 6 have passing legs, frames 3 and 7 are airborne, frames 0 and 4 alternate the leading foot. Do not substitute the same leading-leg pose in every frame.
